reviewed_by: Claude review of the OpenRouter reasoning-channel deduplication
reason: A DeepSeek chat through OpenRouter rendered its thinking as overlapping lines ('The' / 'The user' / 'user just'). _openai_message_reasoning concatenated reasoning_content, reasoning and reasoning_details[].text with newlines, but OpenRouter mirrors the same fragment in reasoning and reasoning_details, so every streamed token was emitted twice and stored twice. The reader now takes the first channel that carries text. Selected the provider suite (the reader, the streaming loop and the non-streaming path) and the chat suite (reasoning deltas are persisted and replayed through chat turns).
exclusions: No full suites. tests/v3/test_harnesses.py is excluded: it does not exercise reasoning extraction, and two of its cases (test_chat_rolls_over_to_current_command_runtime_without_mutating_frozen_session[False|True]) fail identically on main (5bb5f8a) with AttributeError: 'Commands' object has no attribute 'manager' at harnesses.py:5618. No frontend or Playwright entries: the change is confined to the provider reader, no UI file or style changed, and the thinking panel renders whatever deltas the stream carries.
